about: Golden rows for tests/rules-test.js, generated by tests/fixtures/make-rules-golden.js from the old copies of the rules at tag review-base-b (commit b3ecf4d, 18 Nov 2026), never from shared/rules.js. Money is in dollars, not rounded, exactly as each source computed it. Synthetic inputs only.

generatedFrom.duty: tools/stamp-duty-calculator.js calculate() (general, owner, firstHome, firstHomeLand, foreignSurcharge); tools/first-home-buyer-grants-calculator.js fhbDuty(…, true) for newBuild, checked against journey.js buyerDutyAt()
generatedFrom.foreign: tools/cost-of-purchase-calculator.js buyerDuty() plus the surcharge (the QLD 1 Aug 2026 rule)
generatedFrom.lmi: journey.js lmiRate(), budgetLmi(), budgetLoan(); tools/stamp-duty-calculator.js estimateLmiTier() labels and on-screen LMI; tools/first-home-buyer-grants-calculator.js estimateLmi()
generatedFrom.h2bColumns: state, area, price, buyers, dependants, income, build, journey issue (null, price or income), journey h2bOpen, share (price x journey equity), grants calculator [eligible, incomeCap, propertyCap, equityShare, governmentEquity, yourBorrowingRequired] or null (no dependants input, no income)
generatedFrom.schemes: tools/first-home-buyer-grants-calculator.js calculate(), fdsEligibility(), helpToBuyEligibility(); journey.js fdsOk(), h2bIssue(), h2bOpen(), h2bEquity()
generatedFrom.tax: tools/borrowing-power-calculator.js approxTax(), hecsAnnual(), hemMonthly(), incomeTypeFactor(), calc()
generatedFrom.borrowJourney: journey.js borrowLimit() (dependants capped at 3, no HELP, debts or declared living costs, as today)
generatedFrom.journeyStep3: journey.js renderBudgetDash() figures: buyerDutyAt, otherCosts, budgetLmi, budgetLoan, cap x deposit + costs, payAt(loan, 6) and payAt(loan, 9)

intendedMoves.what: A first home buyer who chooses Investor pays the general rate. Today the pages give the first home concession. Rows: state, price, today, rules.
QLD first home vacant land bought as an investment pays the general rate. Today the all-states and QLD pages show $0. Rows: state, price, today, rules.

intendedMoves.phase: 6 (lane A: a new-home choice on the all-states page)
intendedMoves.what: A first home buyer’s new home pays no duty in QLD and SA. The all-states page has no new-home choice today, so it shows the established-home figure. Rows: state, price, today (established), rules (new home).

intendedMoves.phase: 6 (lane A: the all-states and QLD pages)
intendedMoves.what: A QLD foreign buyer pays the general rate plus the 8% surcharge (cost of purchase already does). Today the all-states and QLD pages add the surcharge to the concessional duty. Rows: state, price, firstHome, owner-occupier, today (duty + surcharge), rules (duty + surcharge).
QLD owner-occupier duty on the deposit and cost of purchase pages: none differ today (tests/state-duty-sync-test.js section 4a).
The stamp duty, deposit and cost of purchase pages count LMI in the cash needed today; purchase() adds it to the loan (the Journey’s rule). Not a change to any figure in this file.
journey.js borrowLimit() caps dependants at 3; borrow() does not. The Journey passes min(3, dependants) until phase 4 (see borrowJourney rows with 5 dependants).

journey.js incomeCeiling() at a 2% deposit always uses the Help to Buy loan, even above the Help to Buy price cap. purchase() applies a scheme only where it fits. journeyCeiling rows at dep 0.02 carry the old figure.
